metadata.title: Email Records
metadata.description: Defines trust properties required to treat email as an institutional record subject to retention, disposition, and legal obligations. This pattern addresses classification, legal holds, auditability, and evidentiary defensibility, and does not address phishing, identity spoofing, or data loss prevention.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for managing email as an institutional record subject to retention, disposition, and legal obligations.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Email archiving systems, retention controls, eDiscovery tooling, and records management platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing retention, disposition, and evidentiary integrity of email communications.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Email records assume baseline delivery assurance, identity binding, and accountability are in place.

props.name: data-object
props.remarks: Email messages and associated metadata preserved as evidentiary institutional records.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for guidance on accountability, auditability, and evidentiary support expectations for trustworthy email.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for guidance on email system auditability, retention, and defensible administration.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced to emphasize survivability, integrity, and recoverability of institutional records under disruption or legal obligation.

metadata.remarks: Email Records defines trust properties required to treat email as an institutional record rather than transient communication. It governs retention classification, legal holds, auditability, and defensibility.

components.title: Email Record Classification
components.description: Determines when email content constitutes an institutional record subject to governance.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection or exposure of sensitive information via retained email records.

props.name: defensive-technique
props.remarks: Identification and logging of records to support classification and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email records are identified and managed in accordance with records management requirements.
Policies define which email communications constitute institutional records.

components.title: Retention and Disposition Control
components.description: Ensures email records are retained and disposed of in accordance with policy and legal requirements.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized deletion or destruction of email records.

props.name: defensive-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle controls enforcing retention and authorized disposition of records.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email records are retained for durations consistent with legal and institutional requirements.
Mechanisms prevent unauthorized destruction or removal of required email records.

components.title: Legal Hold and eDiscovery Support
components.description: Supports preservation and production of email records under legal or regulatory obligation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized modification or tampering with retained email records.

props.name: defensive-technique
props.remarks: Integrity protection and verification of retained email records.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms protect email records against unauthorized modification.
Audit review supports verification of record preservation and legal production.
